 Market wrap: Bajaj Finance, Cipla, Nestle India, Eternal top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Thursday
 SECTIONS Market wrap: Bajaj Finance, Cipla, Nestle India, Eternal top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Thursday By Kumar Gaurav , ETMarkets.com Last Updated: Oct 22, 2026, 05:22:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Indian equity markets fell for a third consecutive session as weak global cues and sustained selling weighed on sentiment. The Nifty 50 declined 0.54% to 22,688, while the Sensex dropped 0.62% to 73,249.
 ETMarkets.com Indian equity benchmarks extended their losing streak to a third consecutive session on Thursday, as persistent selling pressure and weak global cues weighed on investor sentiment. Markets opened lower and extended losses in early trade, with the Nifty 50 falling more than 1% intraday, before late-session buying helped trim losses.
 The Nifty 50 declined 124 points, or 0.54%, to close at 22,688, while the BSE Sensex shed 460 points, or 0.62%, to settle at 73,249.
Broader markets underperformed the benchmarks, with the Nifty Smallcap 100 and Nifty Midcap 100 indices falling around 1% each. Meanwhile, the India VIX, a gauge of expected market volatility, edged up to 15.82, signalling heightened caution among investors.
Sectorally, the Nifty Auto, Nifty FMCG, Nifty Metal and Nifty IT indices declined by up to 1%. Market breadth remained firmly negative on the NSE , with 2,512 stocks declining against 1,026 advances, while 104 stocks ended unchanged.

 Agencies Technical View 
From a technical point of view, Nifty50 remained largely range-bound between 22,600 and 22,785 for the remainder of the session, with the 22,800 zone acting as a near-term key resistance, according to Ponmudi R, CEO of Enrich Money. On the upside, reclaiming 22,800 would be necessary to improve near-term stability and create scope for a recovery.
On the downside, the 22,600–22,550 range forms the immediate support zone, Ponmudi believes. A sustained breakdown below 22,500 could accelerate selling pressure and drag the index towards the 22,300–22,200 region.
"Momentum indicators remain weak, with the RSI near 44, indicating a bearish bias. The MACD histogram remains positive at 68.85, with the MACD line at -167.07 above its signal line at -235.92, suggesting that some recovery momentum persists despite the latest decline."
